positioning.first_principle: AI output is not state. AI output is a candidate transition.
positioning.product_claim: dAimon is governed inheritance for AI work.
positioning.carrier_posture: Carrier-agnostic, with Gemini and Google infrastructure as primary contest surfaces.
positioning.contest_boundary: A contest-bounded vertical slice of the enterprise trust layer, not a production compliance platform.

layers.name: Continuity Substrate
layers.question_answered: What may the next AI session inherit?
responsibilities: Import messy AI work as witness material rather than trusted state.
Classify source material into governed continuity objects.
Route objects into settlement queues with explicit proof requirements.
Issue receipts that separate accepted state, rejected witness, deferred material, and caveated claims.
Build inheritance bundles containing only receipt-cleared objects.
next_build_targets: Persist every continuity object and receipt through MongoDB Atlas in the default contest path.
Expose accepted-only inheritance through a small API surface.
Add dashboard review states for accepted, rejected, deferred, and needs_review objects.

layers.name: Generative Governance Engine
layers.question_answered: What kind of governed intelligence does this problem require?
responsibilities: Translate an objective into implicated domains, context packages, roles, templates, proof obligations, and settlement paths.
Generate work packets for carriers without granting them authority to mutate accepted state directly.
Detect when a domain has become too broad, noisy, or proof-divergent and should undergo domain fission.
Route work by capability, authority, context requirement, risk, side effects, and settlement target.
Settle branch outputs into receipts before any future session inherits them.
next_build_targets: Implement objective-to-domain cartography.
Generate context packages from accepted receipts.
Produce work packets for Gemini, Codex CLI, local scripts, and human reviewers.
Add fission recommendations when domain signals exceed threshold.

layers.name: Enterprise Trust Layer
layers.question_answered: How can an enterprise prove what its AI work relied on?
responsibilities: Represent every meaningful AI action as a receipt-bearing graph event.
Trace inherited context back to settlement decisions and proof artifacts.
Preserve rejected and deferred objects as witness without letting them become trusted state.
Expose audit queries across receipts, objects, domains, routes, validations, and releases.
Maintain clean non-claims for legal, compliance, and production readiness boundaries.
next_build_targets: Add graph query API over MongoDB-backed continuity data.
Add audit export for receipt chains and inheritance bundles.
Add enterprise role and authority policy models.
Add partner adapter manifests for Arize, Elastic, Fivetran, and GitLab.
Add hosted dashboard with receipt drill-down and claim status.

layers.name: Partner Adapter Fabric
layers.question_answered: How can dAimon connect partner systems without confusing integration with trust?
responsibilities: Represent each partner as a governed context surface with read/write capabilities, authority boundaries, proof obligations, and non-claims.
Normalize partner outputs into candidate continuity objects before settlement.
Preserve source-specific provenance, freshness, and authority metadata.
Expose adapter status without claiming unproven live integration.
Route future partner work through receipt and inheritance gates.
next_build_targets: Capture Agent Builder/MongoDB MCP trace as the first live partner proof.
Add Arize/Phoenix trace fixture for dAimon runs.
Add Elastic receipt/evidence search fixture.
Add GitLab issue/MR receipt fixture.
Add Fivetran connector metadata fixture.

layers.name: Contest Vertical Slice
layers.question_answered: Can the trust primitive be demonstrated end to end inside the hackathon boundary?
responsibilities: Show messy AI work entering as candidate material.
Show classification into objects and settlement queue entries.
Show accepted-only visibility trace with receipt citations.
Show excluded witness objects remaining visible but non-inheritable.
Show a next-session bundle for Gemini-era agents.
Show the demo package itself governed by claims, proof, and non-claims.
next_build_targets: Add minimal web dashboard for settlement and trace inspection.
Add Google Cloud Run deployment path.
Add Gemini or Agent Builder handoff proof.
Package self-demonstrating video assets and claim audit receipts.
